title: Apple discloses deal to hire team and license tech from personalized podcast startup Huxe | TechCrunch
summary: Apple revealed in a regulatory filing that it has reached an agreement to bring on team members and technology from personalized audio startup Huxe, in what’s commonly known as a reverse acqui-hire deal.
